summary: Defines an extension to RADIUS so it can support Digest Authentication, used by HTTP-style protocols such as SIP and HTTP. It lets a RADIUS server check digest credentials on behalf of another server. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: When a web or phone server wants to check a password without seeing it, it can ask a central RADIUS server. This adds the messages needed for that.

questions: how to use radius with sip digest
